inspiration.observed_pattern: A symmetric-difference report uses two LEFT JOIN anti-joins, one from each relation, and combines the unmatched identifiers with UNION ALL before deterministic ordering.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one inventory-only row and one scan-only row while retaining the directional anti-joins, UNION ALL, and incompatible-branch NULL projection that exposes set-result character metadata.

fixture_notes: One inventory-only row and one scan-only row are sufficient to expose the UNION ALL result metadata difference between MariaDB VAR_STRING and MySqweel STRING for the CAST(NULL AS CHAR) branch.
determinism_notes: The two fixed IDs and labels are ordered by unique item ID. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_inventory (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, item_label VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE mini_scans (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, scan_label VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT i.item_id AS item_id, i.item_label, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(16)) AS scan_label FROM mini_inventory i LEFT JOIN mini_scans s ON s.item_id = i.item_id WHERE s.item_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT s.item_id AS item_id, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(16)) AS item_label, s.scan_label FROM mini_scans s LEFT JOIN mini_inventory i ON i.item_id = s.item_id WHERE i.item_id IS NULL ORDER BY item_id
